name: Climate Emergency Grant Program
summary: Rapid grants for First Nations and First Nation-mandated organisations in British Columbia to respond on the ground to wildfire, drought, flood or landslide damage to aquatic habitat and species.

amount.note: Total budget of CAD 300,000 per fiscal year for all projects

reporting: A single project update report form at the end of the project period.

status.quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until available funds are fully allocated

calls.note: Open until the year's funds are fully allocated

applicant_types.quote: First Nations in B.C. First Nation-led organizations in B.C., including but not limited to: Tribal councils First Nation alliances First Nation-mandated societies

geography.quote: All applicant organizations must be First Nation-led and formally mandated by one or more First Nations in British Columbia.

access.quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until available funds are fully allocated

window.quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until available funds are fully allocated

amount.quote: Funding through the Climate Emergency Grant Program provides a minimum of CAD $25,000 per project. A total budget of CAD $300,000 is available each fiscal year to support all approved projects.

reporting.quote: Successful applicants are required to complete a single project update report form at the end of the project period.
